question: Can the frozen v2 capability/acquisition semantics represent an independently validated direct-execution primitive family whose preferred primitive requires neither a new resident representation nor an acquisition action, without abusing residency state, inventing acquisition/lifetime semantics, or changing the v2 registry/policy core?

falsification_cases.encoding: Preferred direct primitive + validated baseline fallback; no acquisition paths; preferred has PRIMITIVE_NO_EXTRA_REPRESENTATION and zero residency.
falsification_cases.expected: Preferred route when direct execution is available.
falsification_cases.fail_condition: Frozen v2 reaches no acquisition candidate and routes fallback even when preferred execution_available=true.

falsification_cases.encoding: Set runtime resident=true for the preferred direct primitive solely to enter v2 preferred-reuse branch.
falsification_cases.prohibited_reason: The holdout has no new resident representation or residency lifecycle. resident=true would overload representation residency as generic readiness.

falsification_cases.encoding: Add a synthetic mandatory or amortized acquisition path for I002.
falsification_cases.prohibited_reason: I002 evidence contains no acquisition action; this invents semantics solely to fit the abstraction.

falsification_cases.encoding: Use preferred I002 primitive as its own fallback.
falsification_cases.prohibited_reason: Erases the independently valid baseline fallback and cannot express preferred-unavailable -> baseline decision.

pass_rule: An evidence-faithful registration with no acquisition/residency abuse reproduces all frozen oracle decisions using byte-identical v2 generic files.
fail_rule: Correct preferred-direct selection requires residency overloading, invented acquisition semantics, loss of the real fallback, or a v2 generic-file change.
